1792 Bottled in Bond.profile: Vanilla, rye spice, caramel, apple, oak, and brown sugar.

Basil Hayden.profile: Light honey, tea, mint, citrus, vanilla, and gentle spice.

Blue Note Juke Joint.profile: Caramel, vanilla, fruit, oak, spice, and brown sugar.

Booker's.profile: Peanut, vanilla, brown sugar, oak, baking spice, and big Beam funk.

Booker’s Bourbon Batch 2026-01 “Big Easy.summary: Booker’s Bourbon Batch 2026-01 “Big Easy Batch” is a 129.1 proof straight bourbon aged 7 years, 2 months, and 15 days. Breaking Bourbon describes it as a complex, fruit-forward release with confectionery sweetness and a dry, spicy finish.

Buffalo Trace.profile: Caramel, vanilla, light cherry, brown sugar, and soft oak.
Buffalo Trace.description: A balanced everyday bourbon from Buffalo Trace.
Buffalo Trace.verdict_notes: Great daily pour at retail. Do not chase it too hard when shelves have good alternatives.

Chattanooga Whiskey 111.profile: Honey malt, caramel, cocoa, baking spice, oak, and dried fruit.

Chattanooga Whiskey 111.description: A high-malt bourbon from Chattanooga Whiskey.
Chattanooga Whiskey 111.verdict_notes: Distinctive profile and a good craft value.

David Nicholson 1843.profile: Honey, vanilla, oak, caramel, wheat bread, and spice.
David Nicholson 1843.description: A 100-proof wheated bourbon from Lux Row.
David Nicholson 1843.verdict_notes: Quietly useful bottle for wheated bourbon fans.

E.H. Taylor Barrel Proof.profile: Brown sugar, dark cherry, oak, cinnamon, vanilla, and powerful heat.
E.H. Taylor Barrel Proof.description: A barrel-proof release in the E.H. Taylor lineup.

Elijah Craig Barrel Proof.profile: Caramel, peanut brittle, oak, dark fruit, leather, spice, and long warmth.
Elijah Craig Barrel Proof.description: A widely respected barrel-proof bourbon from Heaven Hill.
Elijah Craig Barrel Proof.verdict_notes: One of the best regular barrel-proof buys when stores keep it close to retail.

Elijah Craig Small Batch.profile: Caramel, oak, vanilla, baking spice, brown sugar, and orange peel.
Elijah Craig Small Batch.description: A dependable small batch bourbon from Heaven Hill.
Elijah Craig Small Batch.verdict_notes: A sturdy shelf bourbon that rarely needs hunting.

Evan Williams Bottled in Bond.profile: Caramel, vanilla, oak, peanut, pepper, and brown sugar.
Evan Williams Bottled in Bond.description: A budget bottled-in-bond bourbon from Heaven Hill.
Evan Williams Bottled in Bond.verdict_notes: One of the best inexpensive workhorse bourbons.

Evan Williams Single Barrel.profile: Honey, caramel, oak, apple, vanilla, and gentle spice.
similar: Henry McKenna 10 Year Bottled in Bond
Evan Williams Single Barrel.description: A vintage-dated single barrel bourbon from Heaven Hill.
Evan Williams Single Barrel.verdict_notes: Nice easy sipper when available at sane pricing.

Ezra Brooks Cask Strength.profile: Caramel, oak, vanilla, spice, char, and dark sugar.
Ezra Brooks Cask Strength.description: A cask strength bourbon from Ezra Brooks.
Ezra Brooks Cask Strength.verdict_notes: Good value when you want proof without allocation drama.

Four Roses Limited Edition Small Batch.profile: Red fruit, floral spice, oak, vanilla, cocoa, rye, and long sweetness.
Four Roses Limited Edition Small Batch.description: An annual limited blend from Four Roses.
Four Roses Limited Edition Small Batch.verdict_notes: Frequently excellent; the release year matters a lot.

Four Roses Single Barrel.profile: Ripe fruit, floral spice, vanilla, rye spice, cocoa, and oak.
Four Roses Single Barrel.description: A high-rye single barrel bourbon with great shelf availability in many markets.
Four Roses Single Barrel.verdict_notes: A reliable buy and one of the best non-hype bottles in the aisle.

Four Roses Small Batch.profile: Red fruit, honey, baking spice, light oak, and floral rye.
Four Roses Small Batch.description: A blend of Four Roses bourbon recipes with a balanced profile.
Four Roses Small Batch.verdict_notes: Dependable shelf pick for fruit and spice.

Four Roses Small Batch Select.description: A higher-proof Four Roses small batch expression.
Four Roses Small Batch Select.verdict_notes: Very good bottle when you want fruit, spice, and proof without the chase.

George Remus Bourbon.profile: Caramel, rye spice, vanilla, fruit, oak, and pepper.
similar: New Riff Bottled in Bond Bourbon

George T. Stagg.description: A barrel-proof Buffalo Trace Antique Collection bourbon.
George T. Stagg.verdict_notes: A benchmark high-proof bourbon, but never confuse MSRP value with market value.

Heaven Hill Heritage Collection 22-Year-.style: 22 year barrel proof Kentucky straight bourbon

Henry McKenna 10 Year Bottled in Bond.profile: Caramel, oak, nutty vanilla, spice, leather, and dried fruit.

Henry McKenna 10 Year Bottled in Bond.verdict_notes: Can be excellent, but single barrel variation is real.

Jack Daniel's Bonded.profile: Banana, caramel, oak, vanilla wafer, spice, and maple.

Knob Creek 12 Year.profile: Oak, peanut brittle, caramel, vanilla, leather, spice, and dark sugar.

Knob Creek 9 Year.profile: Peanut, oak, caramel, vanilla, char, and baking spice.

Peerless Double Oak Bourbon.profile: Chocolate, toasted oak, maple, caramel, vanilla, and spice.

Rebel 100.profile: Honey, vanilla, wheat bread, caramel, light oak, and pepper.

Smoke Wagon Small Batch.profile: Caramel, dried fruit, vanilla, spice, oak, and toasted sugar.
